name: @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-wrapper
description: npm workspaces root for the performance tests: links test-liveops-sdk and test-liveops-mini-games, cloned into this folder.

scripts.frame: npm run build -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-sdk && concurrently -k -n sdk,frame -c magenta,green "npm run dev -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-sdk -- --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev:frame -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-mini-games"
scripts.frame:prod: npm run build -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-sdk && npm run build:frame -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-mini-games && npm run preview:frame -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-mini-games
scripts.frame:deploy: npm run build -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-sdk && npm run build:frame -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-mini-games && npm run deploy:frame -w @betty-mini-games/test-liveops-mini-games
